testing_progress.highlight: Devnet blocked by slow key loading; compact key loading (leanVM PR 802) needed before local runs can scale beyond a few validators
Nimbus still on old spec (2^20 leaves); Lighthouse and Lodestar working; Prysm in progress; Teku (Paul) not yet interoping; ethlambda pq-devnet-0 branch ready later today
Single-client local runs confirmed: Lighthouse+Lodestar interop working with few validators; no aggregation observed yet at 1,000 validators

networking_p2p.highlight: gossip-sub insufficient for PQ aggregates: simulations show 200–300 Mbps bandwidth spikes, 7× more bandwidth than announce-and-pull
Anton's simulation (800K validators, 16 subnets, 2 aggregators/subnet, D=4 gossip-sub): attester nodes at capacity, P99 aggregates arrive at 11.7s; local block builder P99 at 8s
Path forward: Waggle + seacast (segmented broadcast); Lighthouse has 8411 Waggle implementation; Csaba's seacast-on-Waggle implementation for Prysm running; seacast-rs (Rust) also WIP
Cross-checking simulations requested before drawing conclusions; Csaba: newer pull-based protocols give a 2–3× bandwidth reduction vs gossip-sub

aggregation_benchmarks.highlight: LeanVM 16-to-1 aggregation ~3.5s on Kev's NUC without the EL (EL adds 10–20%); ~2s when LeanVM gets 6 performance cores with the EL alongside
Expected ~1,500 XMSS signatures/subnet at 800K validators / 16 committees; staggered aggregation (500ms apart) got early positive feedback

pq_migration_and_credentials.highlight: XMSS signature verification added to PQ registration system contract (EIP updated by Justin + Ignacio); working contract in the pq-staking-contracts repo
Proposal: disallow new 0x00 and 0x01 validator deposits at H-star fork; would depend on EIP-8148 (custom sweep threshold); Barnabas and Justin both prefer not burning ETH, mechanism deferred
Best-case consolidation from 0x02-only: validator set could drop from 800K to ~54K (or under 100K), potentially eliminating recursive aggregation
0x00 validators who forgot to migrate: proposal to move funds to EL contract recoverable by original depositor address; no consensus reached, deferred async
